title: Big Sister
paragraphs: “Yes, that’s right.”
Upon my words, Ren, Itsuki, and Father looked at each other, visibly drained.
“Ah, Ren, you thought so too? I started thinking that after meeting Sadeena-san, but Motoyasu-kun didn’t deny it back then.”
“It was when Ren-san mentioned there were three Filolials.”

“Yeah. Motoyasu didn’t react in particular, so I didn’t question it, but… there was something inconsistent or off about Motoyasu’s story. He said that someone named Filo was Father’s first Filolial, but then he called her the older sister, right? I’d been curious about it for a while, but since so many incidents kept happening and Motoyasu didn’t deny it, I never asked.”
“I had forced myself to rationalize it, thinking maybe a younger Filolial grew up and took on the role of an older sister to this Filo girl…”
“Well, Filolials do have individual differences.”
At that point, Older Sister grabbed Father’s arm and leaned in, asking eagerly. Why is Older Sister so excited about this?
“Oh my, then what’s the name of this little sister of mine?”

The older sister? The older sister was a very spirited and strong-willed person. She was enslaved in Melromarc, but like the panda and the Hakuko slave, I imagine she ended up in Zeltoble as a combat slave or something. Or perhaps she maneuvered things well, like Older Sister.

That’s what I thought, but I vividly remember when I foolishly tried to help her, and she asked me if I could treat a weakened slave and teach them how to fight. I failed at that, so I thought it was some kind of trick question. I assumed it was a message I had missed, telling me to recognize the demi-human discrimination in this country.
There’s no way I could ever forget the older sister’s name. After all, she’s Filo-tan’s older sister.
“Her name is Raphtalia. She’s Filo-tan’s older sister and, in the first world, was Father’s right hand whom he deeply relied on.”
Father staggered, putting a hand to his forehead, and Older Sister supported him while narrowing her eyes.
“Motoyasu-kun…”
Father let out a sigh of exasperation. Oh? Did I mess up again?
“Naofumi-san.”
Itsuki crossed his arms and then gestured with his hand.
“Welcome.”
Father slumped down. Then, Ren spoke up loudly.
“Motoyasu, again!?”
“Seriously, give me a break already!”
“It’s partly our fault for not listening carefully, but… this is…”
Unlike the exhausted Father, Older Sister looked at me with great interest.
“So, Motoyasu. Do you know where to find this Raphtalia?”
“I do not. I’ve never met her in any world other than the first one.”
“What!?”
“Oh, come on…”
“Naofumi-san, you’d better be prepared for her to be as hard to find as Rishia-san.”
“Ugh… I guess it’s my turn now. Motoyasu-kun, what kind of girl is this Raphtalia?”

The older sister? Raphtalia-nee-san is a beautifully well-proportioned girl. She’s a demi-human of the tanuki type, with brown hair that reached down to her back. She called herself the sword of the defenseless Father and frequently trained. I remember fondly how she used to do push-ups and other training on Cal Mira Island. After learning some kind of school or style, she became even stronger, especially in combat.
At that moment, Older Sister raised her index finger suggestively and answered Father and the others.
“Raphtalia-chan, hmm… She’s about the same size as Sakura-chan, the girl Naofumi-chan and the others are taking care of, right?”
“No, that’s not right. She’s about the same height as Éclair.”
What is she talking about? The Raphtalia I know had that kind of appearance.
“Sadeena-san, do you know her?”
“Yes, she’s one of the children I’ve been looking for…”
“I see. So, Motoyasu-kun’s description doesn’t match the appearance. Motoyasu-kun, tell us more.”
“Her ears and tail were like a tanuki’s… What was the name of her species again? Ah, I think I heard something like Raccoon.”
I remember the Crimson Swine complaining about that.
“Raccoon type? Then she must have had a rather plump body, right?”
Is the panda giving some sort of explanation about her species? Raphtalia wasn’t chubby at all.
“No, her looks were comparable to Older Sister. Her body wasn’t fat either.”
“It’s a species prone to gaining weight, but she was different?”
“…Yes, Raphtalia-chan was more on the slender side.”
“Demi-humans do experience accelerated physical growth with level-ups, right? Wyndia-san and Imiya-san, who are in our group, are both on the smaller side, though.”
“Not as fast as the growth of the Filolials, though.”
“Most likely, what Motoyasu-kun saw was her post-growth form.”
“Naofumi-chan, can I ask a favor too? I’ve been searching as well, but I haven’t seen her in Zeltoble.”
Oh? Older Sister is asking Father with more enthusiasm than usual. Is something going on?
“If we ask the slave market in Zeltoble, they might be able to order her, but… If we can’t find her, then there’s a high possibility she’s still in Melromarc, where Sadeena-san originally came from.”
Father began analyzing the situation.
“Should we hurry and go search for her…?”
“Yes. Naofumi-san, I had a hard time finding Rishia-san too. I think we should ask the Queen for help.”
“That’s true. We were already planning to look for that Filo girl in Melromarc, so this works out well.”
“Naofumi-chan, can I go with you too?”
“If she’s an acquaintance of Sadeena-san, of course. Motoyasu-kun, is there anyone else? Any other missing companions?”
“Let’s see…”
As far as I remember, we’ve pretty much gathered everyone, haven’t we? Honestly, I think Raphtalia is the only one left. Ah, no… There’s someone else.
“The younger sister of that Hakuko slave was also in the village.”

At first, I thought she was the problematic younger sister of the Hakuko slave, but something happened that made me change my perception. She shielded Father, Filo-tan, and even the Filolial-sama with her own body from the explosion of the Phoenix.
“Should we search for that guy Fohl’s sister too?”
“Anyone else?”
“I heard that the land Father obtained originally belonged to Éclair’s parents and was the hometown of the older sister. I also heard that Father gathered slaves from that place.”

Keel was one of them. Ah, speaking of which, I had completely forgotten about Keel. That dog that turns into a pig is missing. I remember he was close to Mole, but this time Keel is gone, and last time Mole was the one missing.
“I don’t remember the names of everyone from that group, but Keel was one of them.”
“Sadeena-san, do you know this Keel kid?”
“Yes, he’s a close friend of Raphtalia-chan.”
“So… basically, most of Sadeena-san’s acquaintances ended up as my companions.”
“Oh my, then this is perfect. Naofumi-chan, can’t we save all the children from the village?”
“At this point, yeah. Sadeena-san has done a lot for us, so it’s fine. I’m sure Éclair also wants to focus on rebuilding the territory.”
That’s true. Like in the first world, having a base makes things much easier. Just like Father’s village. At that moment, Older Sister averted her gaze slightly as she answered.
“The lord, huh… If that person hadn’t died, things might have turned out a little better.”
“You knew about that?”
“Oh? Didn’t I mention it?”
“This is the first I’m hearing of it! And you know about Eclair-san too, don’t you? She dreams of rebuilding that territory!”
“Well, who knows? From what I’ve seen, Eclair-chan seems more interested in martial arts.”
“…That’s true. Éclair was ordered by the Queen to work with us, so she’s been putting off the reconstruction.”

Indeed, lately, I’ve had the impression that she’s been focusing more on training, preparing for the battle with the Spirit Tortoise. When I mentioned the Phoenix, she talked about training even harder.
“Did you keep quiet about that because you understood her situation?”
“Well, relying on others for everything… that’s not really my style.”
“But… why didn’t Éclair recognize Sadeena?”
“I think she said something like she had seen her before, right? Maybe Sadeena-san and Eclair didn’t interact much?”
That’s possible. Even though it’s Older Sister, she was a villager while Éclair was the lord’s daughter. At that moment, Older Sister answered cheerfully.
“When I was in the territory Eclair-chan’s father managed, I was always in my beastman form. Eclair-chan probably didn’t recognize me.”
“Why would you go so far to hide yourself…?”
“After everything that happened, it was hard to trust someone just because they were the lord’s daughter. Naofumi-chan, you understand, don’t you?”
“Well… yeah. Even the village where Imiya-chan’s relatives are hasn’t exactly been progressing smoothly…”
Is that so? Ren and Itsuki seemed to be doing something in the name of helping with the reconstruction, but it’s not going well? Father seemed to accept that.

“For now, we may not be able to restore the village exactly as it was in the timeline, but let’s work on protecting the children Sadeena-san wants to help. First, we need to search for that Raphtalia girl.”
“Itsuki and I will search for that guy Fohl and his sister. If we find them, we’ll regroup and assist you, so wait for us.”
“I will follow Father as well.”
I need to find Filo-tan. And if Raphtalia is with us, we may also find Filo-tan. That’s the power of sisterly bonds.
“Understood… Alright, let’s head to Melromarc as soon as possible.”
“Understood.”
“As for Sakura-chan and Gaelion-chan… yeah, we can pick them up tomorrow morning.”
“Naofumi-chan.”
“Hmm? Sadeena-san, what is it?”
“Melromarc is a very harsh country for demi-humans. So, please… let’s find Raphtalia-chan and the village children.”
Older Sister pleaded with Father.
“Yeah, you’re right. Let’s pray we don’t face the worst possible outcome.”
And so, we left Sakura-chan and the others behind and teleported to Melromarc.
